items.title: 외국인 또 '팔자'…코스피 나흘 연속 약세

items.title: '귀여운 게 최고'…티니핑·치이카와에 캐릭터株 싱글벙글

items.snippet: 셀트리온[068270]이 올해 3분기 시장 예상치에 부합하는 실적을 거뒀다.셀트리온은 3분기 연결기준 매출액 1조5천억 원, 영업이익 5천100억 원을 기록했다고 12일 공시했다.각각 전년 동기 대비 45.77%, 69.21% 증가했다.3분기 영업이익은 시장 예상치에 부합했다.연합인포맥스가 최근 1개월 내 국내 주요 증권사 6곳이 발표한 실적 전망치를 집계한 결과, 셀트리온은 올해 3분기 연결기준 매출액 1조4천535억 원, 영업이익 5천141억 원을 기록할 것으로 예상됐다.sijung@yna.co.kr<저작권자 (c) 연합인포맥

items.snippet: 이재명 대통령이 10일 “품격 없다, 권위 없다 비난하겠지만 경호를 최소화한 뒷골목 삶의 현장 방문도, SNS(소셜네트워크서비스) 소통도, 그분들의 언어로 교감하는 일도 계속할 것”이라고 했다. 최근 이 대통령의 X(옛 트위터) 게시물이 크게 늘어난 것을 두고 우려가 나오고 있는 가운데 SNS 활동을 강화하겠다는 뜻을 분명히 한 것이다. 이 대통령은 이날 밤 X에 “댓글로 국민과 소통하시다가 품격 없다고 비난받고 조롱당하시던 노무현 전 대통령이 떠오른다”면서 이같이 말했다. 이어 “좁은 뒷골목의 부모 형제 자녀들과 소통하고 그분들의 숨결을 느끼며, 국정의 막중한 책임감을 되새기는 순간이 저에게는 귀하디귀하고 또 포기할 수 없다”고 했다. 이 대통령은 11일 또 다른 글에서는 박원순 전 서울시장을 거론하면서 “뛰어난 아이디어맨이셨고 언제나 시민...

items.title: 행안장관, 임은정 감찰 지시… 강경파와 충돌 확산
items.snippet: 11일 윤호중 행정안전부 장관이 김지용 중대범죄수사청(중수청)장 후보자를 공개 비판해온 임은정 광주지방중수청장에 대한 감찰을 지시했다. 윤 장관은 이날 X(옛 트위터)를 통해 “임 청장은 중수청을 수사하는 기관이 아니라 정치하는 기관으로 착각하고 있는 것 같다”며 “우리 사회의 정의를 바로 세우기 위해 신설되는 기관의 간부가 중수청장 후보에 대한 지적질에 골몰하는 모습을 우려하는 눈으로 보는 국민이 많다”며 감찰 지시 배경을 설명했다. 임 청장은 김 후보자를 “반면교사로 삼아야 될 사람”이라고 공개 비판하는 등 반대 목소리를 내 왔다. 감찰 지시에 대해 임 청장은 “사명감을 가지고 잘 대처할 것”이라고 밝혔다. 청와대는 김 후보자를 재검증한 뒤 2일 국회에 인사청문요청안을 제출했지만 추미애 경기도지사 등 여권 강경파들의 공개 반발은 계속됐다....

items.title: 탈모약 건보-농지조사 오락가락, ETF 뒷북 규제… 국민 혼란 키워
items.snippet: 농지 전수조사, 부동산 세금 강화, 기초연금 개편 등 최근 정부가 번복한 주요 정책은 이재명 대통령의 지시로 담당 부처에서 ‘속도전’으로 추진하다 현장 혼란을 키웠다는 공통점이 있다. 국민과 이해당사자, 전문가 의견을 충분히 듣고 예상되는 부작용을 파악하는 등 정책을 정교하게 추진해야 하는데 담당 부처에서 성과 내는 데만 집중하다 혼란을 자초했다는 비판이 나온다. ● 대통령 일방 지시에 부처는 성과 내기 급급11일 정부 안팎에서는 이 대통령이 생중계 국무회의나 소셜네트워크서비스(SNS)를 통해 정책을 즉흥적으로 제시하고 부처가 이를 지상과제로 수행하는 현재의 국정 운영 방식이 바뀌어야 한다고 지적한다. 앞서 이 대통령이 올해 2월 국무회의에서 “농지 관리가 너무 엉망이다. 농지까지 투기 대상이 돼 버렸다”고 지적하면서 농림축산식품부의 농지 전...

items.title: “10년 넘게 추진한 CPTPP 가입 또 제동… 늦을수록 문턱 높아져”
items.snippet: 정부가 10년 넘게 추진해 온 한국의 포괄적·점진적 환태평양경제동반자협정(CPTPP) 가입 신청이 올해도 사실상 무산됐다. 국내에서 가입 논의가 늦어지는 사이 회원국이 늘어나면서 한국의 가입 문턱이 갈수록 높아질 수 있다는 우려가 나온다. 11일 산업계 등에 따르면 CPTPP 가입이 늦어지면서 한국이 새로운 수출 시장을 확보할 골든타임을 놓칠 수 있다는 비판이 제기되고 있다. 미국의 보호무역주의가 강화되면서 수출 시장을 넓히고 다른 나라들과 무역 협력을 강화할 필요성이 커지고 있다. 이런 가운데 CPTPP 가입은 한국과 자유무역협정(FTA)을 체결하지 않은 멕시코 등으로 수출 시장을 넓히고, 회원국들과 공급망 협력을 강화할 기회로 꼽혔다. items.title: 李, 이달 11일간 SNS 65건… 노무현-박원순 소환해 “직접 소통 계속”
items.snippet: 이재명 대통령이 노무현 전 대통령과 박원순 전 서울시장을 연이어 언급하며 “품격 없다, 권위 없다 비난하겠지만 SNS(소셜네트워크서비스) 소통을 계속할 것”이라고 밝혔다. 여권 지지층이 분열된 상황에서 대통령이 전면에 나서 직접 소통을 강화하겠다는 의지를 드러낸 것. 국민의힘은 “국민을 위한 소통이 아닌 지지층 결집 수단으로 SNS를 이용하는 것이냐”고 비판했다. ● ‘노무현·박원순’ 언급한 李 “SNS 계속”이 대통령은 주말인 10, 11일 노 전 대통령과 박 전 시장을 거론하면서 ‘SNS 자제론’을 반박하고 나섰다. 이 대통령은 10일 오후 10시 27분 X에 “댓글로 국민과 소통하시다가 품격 없다고 비난받고 조롱당하시던 노무현 대통령님이 떠오른다. 경호에 사전 답사에 국민들 불편하실까봐 시장 방문조차 자제하셨다는 말도 전해진다”며 “정치...

items.title: ‘방첩 동맹 기준’ 거론한 美… “국정원의 中 방첩활동 관련 불만인듯”
items.snippet: 도널드 트럼프 미국 행정부가 한미 정보협력 논란과 관련해 핵 시설 등 정보 공유뿐만 아니라 ‘방첩(counter intelligence)’ 분야를 지목해 ‘동맹의 기준을 준수하기를 기대한다’고 언급한 배경에 이목이 쏠리고 있다. 미국이 ‘구성 핵시설 발언’ 등 미국 기밀 정보에 대한 보안 문제뿐 아니라 국가정보원의 방첩 활동에 불만을 공개적으로 내비친 것 아니냐는 지적이 나온다. 정부는 ‘한미 간 신뢰가 굳건하다’며 수습에 나섰지만 국민의힘은 정동영 통일부 장관과 이종석 국정원장의 해임을 요구했다. 최근 미국 백악관 당국자는 ‘한미 간 상호 신뢰와 정보 공유’에 대한 질문에 ‘정보 공유’와 함께 ‘방첩’ 분야를 콕 집어 “한국이 수십 년간 이어져 온 동맹의 기준을 준수하기를 기대한다”고 답했다. 방첩은 외국 정보기관의 첩보 활동과 정보 유출...

items.title: “정치 왜 합니까” 강경파 직격한 李 “서민예산 깎고 혈세로 호사”
items.snippet: 김지용 초대 중대범죄수사청(중수청)장 후보자의 국회 인사청문회가 14일 열리는 가운데 김 후보자를 둘러싼 여권 내 전운이 짙어지고 있다. 이재명 대통령이 김 후보자 지명에 반발해 온 강경파를 잇달아 겨냥한 가운데, 윤호중 행정안전부 장관이 강경파와 함께 김 후보자를 공개 비판해 온 임은정 광주지방중수청장에 대한 감찰을 지시한 것. 김 후보자에 대한 추가 검증에도 강경파의 공개 반대가 이어지자 진압에 나선 것으로 풀이된다. 그러나 강경파의 반발도 이어지면서 김 후보자 지명 이후 한 달 넘게 이어진 여권의 내홍이 경기도 국정감사와 김 후보자의 청문회에서 정면충돌할 수 있다는 분석이 나온다.● 李 “정치 왜 합니까” 강경파 저격 윤 장관은 11일 임 청장에 대한 감찰을 지시했다고 밝히면서 “임 청장은 중수청을 수사하는 기관이 아니라 정치하는 기관으...

items.title: 與, ‘한동훈 딸 허위 스펙’ 의혹 집중… 주말 논평 6건 쏟아내
items.snippet: 더불어민주당이 주말 이틀간 무소속 한동훈 의원이 딸의 ‘허위 스펙’ 의혹 수사에 개입했다는 의혹 관련 논평을 6건이나 쏟아내며 집중포화를 퍼부었다. 그러자 한 의원은 민주당 의원들의 김민석 대표 아들 관련 입법 의혹을 다시 거론했다. 민주당이 한 의원이 2022년 법무부 장관 후보자로 지명됐을 당시 제기됐던 딸 관련 의혹을 꺼내 들자 한 의원도 지난해 국무총리 후보자 시절 제기됐던 김 대표의 아들 관련 의혹을 끄집어낸 것이다. 민주당 박성준 수석대변인은 11일 “최근 국회 법제사법위원회 국정감사에서 한동훈 딸 저작권법 위반 혐의 사건이 검찰 단계에서 덮인 사실이 드러났다”며 재수사를 요구했다. 한 의원의 딸은 다른 사람이 만든 수학 문제로 전자책을 제작해 0.99달러에 판매했다는 저작권법 위반 혐의로 고발됐는데, 박균택 의원이 8일 법사위 법...

items.title: 靑 “李, 골프장서 대구 사고 보고 받고 신속 수습 지시”
items.snippet: 청와대가 이재명 대통령이 대구 상가 천장 붕괴 사고가 발생한 10일 가족과 함께 태릉 골프장을 찾았지만 현장에서 사고 관련 보고를 받은 뒤 신속하고 안전한 수습을 지시했다고 11일 밝혔다. 국민의힘 주진우 의원이 “국민 몰래 황제 골프를 쳤다”며 기자회견을 예고하자, 이례적으로 이 대통령의 주말 비공개 일정을 공개하며 대응에 나선 것이다. 청와대는 11일 주 의원의 기자회견 직전 기자단 공지를 통해 “(이 대통령이) 김종철 경찰청장 직무대행과 직접 통화해 인명 피해 상황과 사망자 유무, 부상 정도 등에 대해 자세히 보고받은 후 인명 구조에 총력을 다할 것과 신속하고 안전한 사고 수습에 만전을 기하도록 관계기관에 지시했다”며 이같이 밝혔다. 청와대는 지금까지 이 대통령의 비공개, 주말 일정을 공개하지 않았다. 청와대는 “(일정 공개는) 불필요한...

items.title: [단독]입찰담합 적발 업체들, 3기 신도시서 감리계약 또 수주

items.snippet: 지난 9일 오후 서울 종로구 익선동 한옥 거리. 두 사람이 겨우 지나갈 정도로 좁은 골목길은 세계 각국에서 온 관광객으로 붐볐다. 튀르키예에서 온 오야 에루(45)씨는 “강남이나 명동과 달리 오래된 한옥과 북적이는 골목에서 진짜 한국을 느낄 수 있다”고 했다. 영국에서 왔다는 메건(33)씨는 “이번이 두 번째 서울 방문인데 일부러 종로3가에 숙소를 잡았다”고 했다. 여기서 몇 분만 걸어가면 종묘 돌담을 따라 카페와 공방이 늘어선 서순라길이 나온다. 골목을 돌아 종로3가역 쪽으로 향하면 포장마차가 길게 늘어서 있다. 관광객들은 “골목을 하나 돌 때마다 전혀 다른 풍경이 펼쳐져 시간 가는 줄 모르겠다” “마치 골목길 파노라마 같다”고 했다.

items.title: 공소청이 끝내나, 중수청에 넘기나… “우리 수사 어디서” 기업 혼란
items.snippet: 지난 2일 검찰청에서 수사권이 폐지되고 기소와 공소 유지만 맡는 기관으로 재편된 공소청이 연말까지 남은 수사를 이어가고 있다. 형사소송법에 ‘검사가 수사 중인 사건 가운데 공소시효가 임박하거나 사건의 성질상 불가피한 경우’에는 예외적으로 12월 30일까지 90일간 수사할 수 있게 돼 있기 때문이다. 정규 시간이 끝난 뒤 주어지는 추가 시간, 이른바 ‘인저리 타임(Injury time)’이 공소청에도 주어진 셈이다.

items.title: 성인 1만명 설문조사로 기업 ‘건강 기여도’ 산출

items.snippet: 영화 ‘암살자(들)’에서 육영수 여사 피격 사건의 배후에 박정희 전 대통령이 있을 가능성을 암시했다는 논란이 온라인에서도 확산하고 있다. 이런 가운데 온라인 지식정보 사이트 나무위키에서는 이를 어떻게 기록할지를 두고 2주 가까이 공방이 벌어졌다. 이 과정에서 다른 영화나 보수 진영을 비판하는 서술과 달리, ‘암살자(들)’에 대한 비판에는 지나치게 엄격한 입증 기준을 요구하는 등 정치적 편향 논란도 제기됐다. 국내 웹사이트 방문 순위 최상위권인 나무위키의 영향력이 커진 만큼, 이용자들의 자율적인 편집 과정에서 서술의 공정성을 어떻게 확보할 것인지도 과제로 떠오르고 있다.

items.title: “마운자로 반값이라 샀는데”…‘인도자로’ 열어보니 위험한 정체
items.snippet: 서울에 거주하는 30대 남성 이모씨는 다이어트에 돌입한 지 4개월째다. 185㎝의 장신이지만 최근 몸무게가 105㎏을 넘어서자 여름이 시작되던 지난 6월부터 비만치료제 ‘마운자로’를 처방받기 시작했다. 그런 그에게 최근 고민이 생겼다. 투약 용량을 점차 늘리면서 매달 마운자로 약값으로만 40만원가량 나가게 된 것. 얇아지는 지갑을 지킬 방법을 찾던 이씨는 온라인에서 ‘인도자로(인도+마운자로)’를 발견했다. 이씨는 “가격이 한국보다 절반 이상 저렴하고, 온라인에서 구매 후기와 절차를 찾아볼 수 있다”며 “직접 처방받는 건 아니긴 하지만 이미 많이들 사용하고 있어 부작용 걱정은 크게 없다”고 말했다.

items.title: 목표 명중… 국산 ‘극초음속 미사일’ 성공 공개
items.snippet: 청와대가 이재명 대통령이 참관한 가운데 8일 실시한 국산 극초음속 활공비행체(HGV)의 첫 시험 발사 사진을 하루 뒤인 9일 공개했다.충남 태안 국방과학연구소 안흥종합시험장 인근 해상 고정 바지에서 미사일이 화염과 연기를 내뿜으며 솟구치는 모습. 추진체에서 분리된 활공체가 해면을 향해 가파르게 내려오고 있다. 탄착 직후 물기둥이 치솟는 모습. 청와대는 전날 활공체가 지정된 목표점에 정확히 탄착했다고 밝혔다.

items.title: 유엔서 ‘DMZ 지뢰’ 설전… 韓 “사과하라” 北 “군사 주권”
items.snippet: 정부가 유엔총회에서 비무장지대(DMZ) 지뢰 폭발 사건에 대한 북한의 사과와 책임 있는 조치를 촉구했다. 이재명 대통령이 극초음속 미사일 시험 발사를 참관한 데 이어 국제사회에서 외교적 대응에 나선 것. 하지만 북한은 ‘고의적 공격으로 단정하기 어렵다’는 정동영 통일부 장관의 발언을 거론하며 DMZ 지뢰 폭발 사건에 대해 “불순한 방해 책동(sinister obstructive move)”이라고 주장하는 등 공개 설전을 벌였다. 차지훈 주유엔 대표부 대사는 8일(현지 시간) 미국 뉴욕 유엔본부에서 열린 제81차 유엔총회 제1위원회(군축·국제안보) 일반토의 연설에서 DMZ 지뢰 폭발 사건에 대해 “명백한 정전협정 위반”이라고 지적했다. 이어 “북한이 이러한 긴장 고조 행위를 중단하고 사과하며 책임 있는 조치를 취할 것을 촉구한다”고 강조했다....

items.title: 정청래 美비자 논란에, 외교부 “한미관계 전반과 연계 부적절”

items.title: 우크라, 韓대사 소환에 “감정보다 외교 우선”
items.snippet: 우크라이나가 한국 정부의 박기창 주우크라이나 대사 소환에 대해 “외교가 감정보다 우선해야 한다(diplomacy must prevail over emotions)”는 입장을 냈다. 한국의 사과 요구를 재차 거부한 것. 국민의힘은 정부의 대사 소환 조치에 대해 “앞으로는 우크라이나로부터 북한군 포로를 받지 않겠다는 것”이라고 비판했다. 헤오르히 티히 우크라이나 외교부 대변인은 8일(현지 시간) 영문 성명을 통해 “건설적인 해결책을 모색하기 위해 이번 주 주우크라이나 한국대사를 외교부로 초청해 우크라이나 측 입장을 전달했다”고도 했다. 외견상 ‘초청(invited)’이란 표현을 썼지만 사실상 해당국 대사를 본국 외교부로 불러 항의하는 ‘초치’를 했다는 취지다. 반면 외교부는 9일 “정부는 한국과 우크라이나 간 현안을 관리하고 해결하기 위한 노력을...

items.title: ‘쇼츠 공장’ 논란 부른 국감… 보란듯 막말, 돌아서선 영상 올려

items.title: “우리 말과 글의 힘이 곧 대한민국의 경쟁력”
items.snippet: 이재명 대통령은 9일 한글날을 맞아 “선조들이 지켜낸 한글을 이제 자유롭게 쓰고 있다”며 “광복 이후 한글은 대한민국의 성장과 발전을 뒷받침했다”고 밝혔다. 이 대통령은 이날 페이스북에 “오늘은 세종대왕께서 한글을 반포하신 지 580돌이 되는 한글날이자, 특히 일제 강점기였던 1926년 우리 선조들이 말과 글을 지키고자 처음 ‘가갸날’을 만든 지 100년이 되는 뜻깊은 해”라며 “글은 나라의 얼굴이고, 말은 나라의 심장이다. 우리 말과 글의 힘이 곧 대한민국의 경쟁력”이라고 강조했다. 이 대통령은 “100년 전 선조들은 우리 말과 글을 지키기 위해 온 힘을 다했다”며 “주시경 선생을 비롯한 많은 선각자들은 일제의 탄압에도 우리 말과 글을 연구하고, 기록하고, 가르쳤다. 나라를 빼앗겼어도 우리의 정신과 정체성마저 잃을 수는 없다는 의지였다”고...

items.title: 與 지지율 35%-국힘 26%, 무당층 31%
items.snippet: 한국갤럽 여론조사에서 더불어민주당의 지지율이 이재명 정부 출범 이후 최저치를 기록했다. 민주당 김민석 대표가 8월 17일 취임 당시 100일 이내에 당 지지율을 10%포인트 끌어올리겠다는 목표를 밝힌 가운데 당내에선 “지지율이 오르지 않고 있는 상황을 점검해 볼 필요가 있다”는 우려가 나온다. 한국갤럽이 6∼8일 전국 만 18세 이상 1000명을 대상으로 실시해 9일 발표한 여론조사(전화면접 방식, 95% 신뢰수준에 표본오차 ±3.1%포인트, 자세한 사항은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 홈페이지 참조)에 따르면 정당 지지율에서 민주당 35%, 국민의힘 26%로 각각 집계됐다. 지지하는 정당이 없는 무당층은 31%를 기록했다. 직전 조사(9월 셋째 주)에서 민주당 지지율은 40%, 국민의힘은 27%, 무당층은 25%였다. 한국갤럽은 “여당 지지율 3...

items.snippet: 이재명 대통령(사진)은 9일 “순수한 급진성도 문제겠지만, 능력도 안 되면서 큰 자리를 요구하고 인사나 국가 정책까지 자기 뜻대로 하려다가 잘 안 되니 대의명분 삼아 급진 개혁을 내세우며 내부 공격하는 것이 더 문제”라고 비판했다. 김지용 중대범죄수사청(중수청)장 후보자 지명에 반발하는 범여권 강경파를 겨냥한 것으로 풀이된다. 이 대통령은 이날 오후 X(옛 트위터)에 8·17 더불어민주당 전당대회를 전후로 여권의 분열 양상을 다룬 조희연 전 서울시교육감의 글을 공유하며 이같이 밝혔다. 이 대통령은 조 전 교육감이 “혁명을 위해 동지를 치는 게 아니라 동지를 치는 일 자체가 혁명이 돼 버린다”며 “혁명이 체제(권력)가 되는 순간 순수의 근저에 이익의 시선이 흘러들고 자기 정치와 자기 집단정치의 동학이 작동한다”고 언급한 것을 인용했다. 청와대에...

items.title: “멈춘 소나무재선충 항공방제…내년부터 다시 시작하겠다”
items.snippet: 전국 소나무 숲이 붉게 물들어 가고 있다. 소나무 재선충에 감염돼 말라 죽고 있기 때문이다. 재선충은 침엽수에 기생하는 길이 1㎜의 벌레로, 감염되면 나무 속 물길이 막혀 대부분 말라 죽게 된다. 재선충에 감염된 나무는 2023년 90만그루에서 올해 177만그루로 2배 가까이 폭증했다. 정부는 재선충병이 처음 발생한 1988년부터 올해까지 방제 작업에 1조8930억원을 투입했지만, 억제는커녕 수도권까지 피해 지역이 확산되고 있다.

items.title: 최강 엘니뇨 온다, ‘롤러코스터 겨울’ 예고
items.snippet: 올 연말까지 역대 가장 강력한 엘니뇨가 발생할 것이란 전망이 나왔다. 엘니뇨는 동태평양부터 중태평양에 걸친 엘니뇨 감시구역의 해수면 온도가 6개월 넘게 평년보다 0.5도 이상 높아지는 현상이다. 엘니뇨는 전 지구적 이상 고온을 유발하며, 우리나라엔 겨울철 ‘롤러코스터 추위’를 야기해왔다.

items.title: 일교차 큰 주말… 남부는 우산 챙기세요
items.snippet: 주말인 10~11일 중부 지방은 대체로 맑겠지만 남부 지방은 흐리고 비가 내릴 전망이다. 찬바람이 그치며 기온은 소폭 올라가지만 전국 대부분 지역 일교차가 15도 안팎으로 커 나들이할 때 겉옷 준비가 필요하겠다. 기상청에 따르면 토요일인 10일 전국의 아침 최저기온은 9~20도, 낮 최고기온은 23~27도로 예보됐다. 평년 기온(최저 8∼16도, 최고 21∼24도)과 비슷하거나 약간 높은 수준이다. 서울이 14~26도, 대전이 12~26도, 광주·대구 15~27도, 부산 20~27도, 제주 19~25도를 기록하겠다

items.title: 약국 돌며 ‘감기’ 부르는 이기찬… 약국도 ‘스타 마케팅’
items.snippet: 최근 가수 이기찬이 전국 약국을 돌며 자신의 대표곡 ‘감기’를 부르는 ‘약국 버스킹’이 화제다. 처음엔 가수가 직접 약국을 섭외했지만, 공연 영상이 인기를 끌자 이젠 마케팅 효과를 노리는 전국 약국의 섭외 요청이 이어지고 있다고 한다. 전엔 보기 힘들었던 연예인 약국 광고도 등장했다. 최근 가수 김종국이 한 창고형 약국의 모델로 발탁됐다.

items.title: 이화영의 변호사 “시간 지나면 진실 드러날 것”
items.snippet: 이화영 전 경기도 평화부지사 변호인인 김광민 변호사가 지난 7일 언론에 “이 전 부지사가 이재명 대통령에게 화가 많이 나 있다”며 이 전 부지사의 가석방을 요구하자, 다음 날 이 전 부지사는 김 변호사 인터뷰가 자기 진의와 다르다면서 옥중 입장문을 냈다. 이 전 부지사는 그러면서 “이 대통령의 고뇌에 공감한다”고 했다. 그러자 김 변호사는 같은날 페이스북에 “당사자가 직접 입장을 명확히 하신 만큼, 이 부분에 대해 더 이상의 말은 얹지 않으려 한다”면서도 “진실은 시간이 지나면 자연스레 드러날 것”이라고 했다. 이를 두고 9일 법조계에서는 “이 전 부지사 측이 발언 수위를 조절해 가며 연일 석방을 요구하고 있다”는 반응이 나왔다.

items.title: 한글날, 붓글씨 뽐내는 외국인들
items.snippet: 9일 한글날 100주년을 맞아 서울 광화문 광장에서 열린 ‘한글 휘호 대회’에 참가한 한복 차림의 외국인이 붓을 잡고 한글을 쓰고 있다. 이날 행사는 조선 시대 과거시험을 재현하는 방식으로 진행됐다.

items.title: 분장하고 춤추고… 의사들도 웃겨야 산다
items.snippet: 배 나온 중년 남성이 서울의 한 피부과 복도를 런웨이 삼아 걸었다. 잠옷 차림으로 곰 인형을 안고 나타났다가 힙합 가수처럼 검은색 벙거지에 선글라스를 쓰고 워킹을 했다. 마지막에는 흰 드레스에 왕관을 쓰고 요술봉까지 든 ‘공주’로 변신했다. 카메라에 얼굴을 바짝 들이민 공주는 이 피부과 원장이었다. ‘인생 뭐 있어?’라는 제목의 이 인스타그램 숏폼(짧은 동영상)은 조회 수 42만회를 기록했다.

items.title: 출산율 올랐지만 육아비도 껑충… 예비 부모들 지갑 쥐어짠다
items.snippet: 한글날인 9일 경기 고양시 킨텍스에선 ‘베이비 페어(육아 박람회)’가 열렸다. 1만3000㎡(약 3932평) 규모 전시장에는 유모차와 카시트, 학습지, 보험 등 출산·육아 관련 업체 200여 곳이 부스를 차렸다. 행사장은 유모차를 끌거나 어린아이 손을 잡은 부모와 임산부 부부로 북적였다. 육아 용품을 시중보다 조금이라도 싸게 사려는 사람들이 몰려든 것이다.

items.title: 교육감협의회 회장 안돼 삐졌나… 홀로 두 차례 연속 빠진 안민석
items.snippet: “다른 교육감들이 민주당 출신의 5선 국회의원 경력을 가진 자신을 그냥 초선 교육감으로 생각했다고 해서 이러는 건가?”

items.title: 너와 나, 그리고 코스모스의 가을
items.snippet: 9일 경기 구리 한강시민공원에서 ‘2026 구리 코스모스 축제’가 열렸다. 분홍색 코스모스가 공원을 가득 메웠다. 시민들이 코스모스 꽃밭 사이를 거닐며 가을 정취를 즐기고 있다. 축제는 11일까지 열린다.

items.title: Prize-winning image which sparked backlash was AI-generated, Nikon rules
items.snippet: The camera-maker says it is now re-evaluating the rules and procedures of its Small World in Motion contest.

items.title: 밥 먹고 10분 서 있기… ‘혈당 브레이크’ 밟기 쉽죠?
items.snippet: “평생 몸에서 나오는 호르몬을 다 모아도 찻숟가락 하나가 안 돼요. 눈에 보이지도 않는 그 작은 물질이 내 생각과 감정, 건강을 쥐고 흔들죠.”

items.title: 김세중 교수 ‘난계악학대상’
items.snippet: 난계기념사업회(이사장 홍정수)는 제28회 난계악학대상 수상자로 김세중 홍익대 공연예술대학원 교수를 선정했다고 9일 밝혔다. 소리꾼·배우 이자람씨는 공로상 수상자로 선정됐다.

items.title: [플라자] 흥사단 민족통일운동본부 통일 포럼 개최
items.snippet: ▲흥사단 민족통일운동본부(상임대표 양영두)는 오는 13일 오후 6시 서울 종로구 흥사단 회관에서 ‘한반도 정세 변화와 평화 통일 방향’을 주제로 통일 포럼을 개최한다. 포럼은 강창일 민주평화통일자문회의 수석부의장의 강연 등으로 진행된다.

items.title: “왜 인생은 짧은가”… 2000년 전 철학자에게 삶의 답을 구한다
items.snippet: “당신은 누구에게나 시간을 내주면서, 자기 자신에게는 시간을 내주지 않는다. 그것이 당신의 삶이 짧은 진짜 이유다.”

items.title: “이사 간다”던 70대 후반 선배… 알고 보니 ‘저세상’으로
items.snippet: #“오랜만이요. 잘 지냈지? 나 이사 간다고 전화했어.” 70대 후반의 한 선배가 10년 만에 전화했길래 반겼더니 한 대답이다. “아 네, 좋은 데로 이사 가시군요. 어디로 가세요?” “응, 그건 일단 이사한 후 알려줄게.” 좀 이상했지만 불현듯 생각나 전화한 거겠지 했다. 얼마 후 그가 이사한 곳은 ‘저세상’이었다. 그런 전화를 받았던 상당수가 나중에 부고를 접한 후 충격과 슬픔에 빠졌다.

items.title: 달리고, 노 젓고, 걷다 보면 춘천은 낭만 한도 초과
items.snippet: 서울에서 100km쯤 떨어져 있는 춘천에 가면 꿈틀댄다. 청춘의 기억 세포들이. 윤슬을 머금은 호숫가를 거닐며 아직 오지 않을 미래를 이야기하던 풋내 섞인 시절이 그곳에 있다.

items.title: 로또 1등 당첨돼도 출근하는 이유는…
items.snippet: “준비하시고… 쏘세요!” 두구두구 울리는 북소리가 긴장감을 만들고 날아간 화살이 회전판에 꽂힐 때마다 탄성과 탄식이 오간다. 어린 시절 TV로 주택복권 방송을 온 가족이 모여 보던 광경이다. 당시 저소득층의 주거안정 지원을 목적으로 발행한 주택복권은 1등 당첨금이 300만원으로 당시 집 한 채를 살 수 있는 큰 금액이었다. 하지만 현재 복권의 대명사는 ‘주택복권’이 아니라 2002년에 출시된 ‘로또’다. 1등 당첨금 제한도 없어졌고, 당첨자가 없으면 다음 주로 이월되는 제도가 있어 대한민국 복권 사상 최고액인 407억원 로또 당첨자가 탄생하기도 했다. 집 몇 채가 아니라 실제 ‘인생 역전’을 할 수 있는 액수다. 그래서 ‘로또’는 ‘인생 역전’과 동의어처럼 여겨지기 시작했다. 그렇다면 지금은 어떨까. 평균 실수령액이 14억원 정도다. 복권 가...

items.title: “이 사람 박제합니다”… 화나면 올린다, 왜 ‘박제’는 일상이 됐나
items.snippet: “하도 억울하고 약 오르고 기분 나빠 박제할게요.”

items.title: 일본쌀에 밀렸던 들녘... 한국쌀, 품질로 되찾았다
items.snippet: 추수를 앞둔 경기도 안산 들녘은 황금빛으로 넘실거렸다. 집안 대대로 안산에서 농사를 지어온 송영찬(67)씨가 알곡을 잔뜩 매단 채 고개 숙인 벼를 손으로 부드럽게 훑었다.

items.title: 美 타임스스퀘어 전광판, 단돈 30만원에 ‘한글 게시판’ 됐다
items.snippet: “잠실야구장 마지막 해, 물 뿌려드립니다!” 최근 도심 번화가 옥외 전광판에 짧은 문구가 흘러나왔다. 서울 잠실을 연고지로 삼는 야구팀 LG트윈스 측이 집행한 광고였다. 올해 말 잠실야구장 철거를 앞두고 홈팬들을 불러모아 워터쇼를 제공하겠다는 안내용이었지만, 해당 전광판은 한국에 위치한 게 아니었다. 미국 뉴욕 한복판 타임스스퀘어에 있다. 광고 말미에 “(미국 야구팀) 미네소타 트윈스 아닙니다”라고 익살스레 적어둔 이유다. 전부 한글로 이뤄진, 한국 사람 아니면 이해할 수 없는 외국발 광고. 구단 관계자는 “요새 떠오르는 바이럴 마케팅 방식을 시도했다”며 “비용이 생각보다 저렴해 결정이 쉬웠다”고 말했다.

items.title: “500년 조선의 수도 지킨 이 성곽... ‘1초의 예술’로 세계 홀려볼게요”

items.title: Predicting Nanofabrication Variance: A Conditional Diffusion Model
items.abstract: Micro- and nanostructures fabricated by focused ion beam (FIB) milling invariably deviate from input designs due to systematic and stochastic effects such as ablation-rate fluctuations, and redeposition. As such, nominally identical iterations of a given process yield a distribution of non-identical fabrication outcomes, leading to variations in the physical (optical, mechanical) properties of fabricated structures. Existing models of the milling process typically predict a single deterministic fabrication result, neglecting this variability. Here we present a conditional diffusion model that learns the statistical distribution of process outcomes conditioned on input design, enabling it to predict a realistic distribution of possible output sample structures. These predictions accurately reproduce edge morphology, linewidth variations, and defect probabilities observed in fabricated sam...

items.title: Bottom-Up Surface-Enhanced Raman Scattering for the Detection of Micro-Objects and Globular Analytes
items.abstract: Surface-enhanced Raman scattering (SERS) is typically achieved by depositing the analyte on a metal or semiconductor substrate. We propose a bottom-up approach, enabling SERS by depositing a metal on the surface of the object being studied. A Mie-theory analysis of electric-field enhancement in dielectric core-shell particles is presented. A correlative approach combining SERS, atomic force microscopy, and scanning electron microscopy is employed to model the conditions required for sensitive SERS detection and spectral analysis of polystyrene microspheres (PMSs) as models of globular and vesicle-like objects. items.title: Theory of exciton-exciton interactions in crystalline systems
items.abstract: Excitons are bound electron-hole pairs in semiconductors whose interactions influence optical properties and determine their collective behavior and emergent correlated phases. Despite the theoretical and experimental significance of these phenomena, a microscopic theory of exciton-exciton interactions that takes into account the full composite nature of these quasiparticles is lacking. Here, we present a general theory of exciton-exciton interactions that builds upon our previous publication [Physical Review B 113, 155440 (2026)], which applied only to conventional semiconductors with weak band hybridization. By contrast, the theory presented here is valid in virtually any crystalline semiconducting system and can be applied to the study of biexciton formation and correlated excitonic phases in systems where band topology, quantum geometry, and moiré effects play a significant role. items.title: Orbital transfer reveals material-selective structure in Rydberg excitons
items.abstract: Rydberg excitons in atomically thin semiconductors offer a sensitive view of dielectric screening and electronic structure. As their spectra become increasingly well resolved, a central question is how much material information an effective Hamiltonian can predict beyond the states used to determine it. Using the 1s, 2p and 2s levels to determine a scalar Rytova-Keldysh Hamiltonian, we test its transfer to the excluded 3p state. The transfer deviations have opposite signs: the observed 3p lies 7.38 meV below the prediction in MoSe2 and 5.58 meV above it in WS2; the opposite signs persist across the complete reported +/-2-sigma peak-error boxes. In a separate high-field-calibrated benchmark, RK removes 66.8% of the orbital error of a pure two-dimensional Coulomb reference, making the remaining state-selective deviations particularly informative. items.title: Evolution and breakdown of chiral anomaly in Weyl semiconductor tellurium
items.abstract: Chiral anomaly in topological materials manifests as negative longitudinal magnetoresistance, yet the tunability and evolution of this effect remain elusive. Here we show that doped tellurium serves as a versatile platform to realize a giant negative longitudinal magnetoresistance that is highly tunable via the Fermi level and magnetic field. By moving the Fermi level towards the Weyl point, we observe a pronounced enhancement of negative magnetoresistance, which arises from chiral anomaly and robustly persists up to ambient temperature. Beyond the quantum limit, the system exhibits positive linear magnetoconductance, serving as a compelling transport signature of the chiral anomaly in the lowest Landau level. Notably, in the extreme quantum limit at cryogenic temperatures, the magnetoresistance undergoes a dramatic reversal from negative to positive. This reversal points to a potential...

items.title: Nonlocal Josephson coupling and current redistribution in a large-area graphene multiterminal Josephson junction
items.abstract: Multiterminal Josephson junctions (MTJJs) extend conventional two-terminal Josephson physics to devices defined by multiple superconducting phases, where rich phenomena have been predicted. However, in conventional MTJJs, superconducting transport is often dominated by local coupling between neighboring leads, obscuring physics that goes beyond simple connectivity. Here, we realize a multiterminal Josephson network in a graphene Hall bar geometry with micron-scale dimensions, enabling substantial nonlocal coupling between distant terminals. Our key observation is a pronounced negative differential longitudinal resistance (NDLR) in the four-probe response near switching currents, while no such feature appears in two-terminal measurements. items.title: Measuring the Speed of Light with a Time-of-Flight Setup: An Authentic Experiment for High School
items.abstract: Students often perceive scientific experiments as clean, straightforward procedures with predictable outcomes. Students' beliefs about the nature of experimental physics typically remain inconsistent through the initial stages of undergraduate education. In reality, experimental work in physics involves hands-on activities such as soldering circuits, assembling provisional setups, and building functional mock-ups from simple materials before reliable measurements can be achieved. To address this gap, we designed a laboratory activity in which students were completely involved in the experiment design, construction and operation with the final goal of measuring the speed of light with a low-cost and compact setup. items.abstract: Most systems trained by equilibrium propagation or coupled learning are in the same class as multi-layer perceptrons: while they may be universal function approximators, they struggle to learn associative tasks which are easy for transformers. Equilibrium propagation relies on a bidirectional flow of information through the physical system between input and output. The reverse flow is broken by more complex nonlinear systems, such as those performing multiplication which is needed to express dot-product attention. Here we explicitly restore this bidirectional flow by introducing extra circuit elements for this purpose into a double or dyadic circuit. We then use these ideas to construct an attention mechanism exploiting the exponential current law of sub-threshold MOSFET devices. items.title: Spatiotemporal computing for temporal nonlinear tasks using few-mode fiber and SOA nonlinearity
items.abstract: Step-index few-mode fibers (FMFs) provide a compact passive platform for high-speed photonic information processing by exploiting modal dispersion to map temporal inputs into spatiotemporal representations with short-term memory. In previous studies, we have demonstrated linear classification tasks with such FMFs, such as ultrafast multibit header recognition. Here, we extend the computational capability of such architectures towards solving nonlinear tasks by introducing an optical nonlinearity at the output of the dispersive medium. The FMF output is processed through parallel direct and nonlinear branches, with the latter implemented using a nonlinear semiconductor optical amplifier (SOA). We experimentally evaluate the architecture at 28.5 Gb/s on two delayed XOR and higher-order parity tasks. items.title: Effects of chlorine substitution on the magneto-optical properties of CrSBr
items.abstract: We present a systematic study of the effects of chlorine substitution on the magneto-optical properties of the van der Waals layered semiconductor CrSBr. Our study shows that even at substitution level of $x=56\%$ the $\mathrm{CrSBr_{1-x}Cl_{x}}$ material exhibits qualitatively the same clear magneto-optical coupling that was observed in pure CrSBr crystals. The values of the relevant parameters are shown to vary smoothly across different substitution levels, thus offering promising tunability for this family of 2D magnetic materials.

items.title: Multifunctionality in Janus CrMCN4 (M = Si/Ge) Monolayers: Valleytronic Physics, Piezoelectric Response, and Photocatalytic Potential
items.abstract: Two dimensional Janus semiconductors integrating spin-valley coupling, piezoelectricity, and tunable optical responses offer a platform for multifunctional nanodevices. Here, first-principles calculations reveal complementary composition and strain effects in CrSiCN4 and CrGeCN4 monolayers. Both are found to be nonmagnetic direct-gap semiconductors, with gaps of 1.23 and 1.09 eV using the Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof functional including spin-orbit coupling, respectively. HSE06 hybrid-functional calculations retain the direct-gap character, yielding gaps of 1.46 eV for CrSiCN4 and 1.19 eV for CrGeCN4. Opposite out-of-plane spin character and Berry curvature emerge at K and K'. Biaxial strain reduces the respective gaps from 1.59 to 0.86 eV and 1.44 to 0.63 eV, drives direct-to-indirect transitions, and redshifts absorption while preserving valley spin contrast. items.title: ATLAS: Adaptive TDA-guided Landscape-Aware Transistor Sizing
items.abstract: Analog transistor sizing, finding design parameters that simultaneously satisfy multiple performance specifications, is a labor-intensive bottleneck in circuit design. To support analog circuit experts, various automation methods have been proposed, including Bayesian optimization (BO), reinforcement learning (RL), and others. Yet existing methods are oblivious to the topological structure of a feasible design space, which can fragment into disconnected regions due to operating-regime transitions, conflicting specification trade-offs, and nonconvex device physics. This topological blindness causes the optimizer to converge within a single feasible region while missing others that may contain superior designs. items.title: Band Tail States: Speed Bump or End of the Road for Two-Dimensional Semiconductors?
items.abstract: We propose that the path to realizing the full potential of two-dimensional (2D) electronics lies in understanding and mastering their energy band tail states (BTS). Unlike silicon, which benefits from sharp band edges (Urbach energy $E_\rm U$ ~ 10 meV), today's monolayer 2D semiconductors have rough band edges ($E_\rm U$ ~ 100 meV) caused by spatial potential inhomogeneity. Comparing a physics-based electrical model to experiments, we demonstrate that BTS cause reduced effective mobility and "slow" transistor turn-on with excessive gate voltage in monolayer 2D transistors, which sets a fundamental limit for their energy-efficient operation. We also show that BTS effects in 2D transistors could be mitigated with higher gate capacitance, with strain engineering, and by using bilayer instead of monolayer 2D channels, as long as $E_\rm U$ is reduced below ~ 50 meV. items.abstract: LiGa5O8 is an ultrawide-bandgap oxide semiconductor that has recently been experimentally demonstrated to exhibit p-type conductivity; however, the origin of the observed p-type transport remains poorly understood. The p-conductive films exhibit room-temperature hole concentrations on the order of 10^18 cm^-3. items.title: Quantum-vortex excitons beyond band topology
items.abstract: Optically exciting a typical low-dimensional semiconductor produces a nodeless \(s\)-type exciton as its lowest-energy bound state. Here, we explain how Coulomb phase matching stabilises a quantum-vortex exciton as the lowest bound state in flat Chern bands. Using a prototypical Yin--Yang kagome lattice, we demonstrate that increasing the spin--orbit coupling drives a transition of the lowest exciton from a quantum-vortex state to a zero-winding state, while leaving the band Chern numbers unchanged. We trace this behaviour to a gauge-invariant combination of exciton phase differences and Bloch-overlap phases that can reduce the Coulomb energy. By comparing states with identical wavefunction amplitudes, we isolate this phase contribution and show that it is sufficient to drive the reversal in exciton ordering. Efficient charge extraction depends critically on the band-edge alignment between the absorber and the charge-selective contacts, which is a surface property. Here, we combine first-principles calculations with device-level modelling to investigate the surface energetics and band alignments across the MChX family. An exhaustive sampling of crystal orientations, including low-symmetry facets, identifies the (011) and (010) surfaces as the most stable terminations in all eight compounds. items.title: Bottom-Up Prediction of Amorphous Poly(1,3-dioxolane) using Ab Initio Reactive Machine-Learning Force Fields
items.abstract: Poly(1,3-dioxolane) (pDXL) is a chemically recyclable polyether that can be synthesized by living cationic ring-opening polymerization with precise control of chain length into the ultra-high-molecular-weight (UHMW) regime, where it acquires enhanced mechanical properties. Like most polymers, however, it has amorphous condensed-phase structure, and diffraction measurements alone cannot resolve the atomistic microstructure that underlies them. In this work, we predict the ensemble of the pDXL microstructures by applying a recently developed AI-accelerated ab initio bottom-up polymer structure prediction (AI$^{2}$-BPSP) framework that simulates the living polymerization of pDXL under experimental synthetic conditions with machine-learning force fields trained within van der Waals-corrected hybrid density functional theory. items.title: Ambipolar metal-insulator transition in bilayer MoSe2
items.abstract: When Coulomb interactions dominate kinetic energy, dilute two-dimensional carriers form a Wigner solid. Both its melting and disorder-driven localization can drive density-tuned metal-insulator transitions, but their relative roles and interplay have been debated for decades. Atomically thin semiconductors offer a new test because transport and scanning tunneling microscopy can probe the same material, yet poor contacts impede transport where correlations are strongest. Here we introduce contact-free radio-frequency reflectometry that senses sheet resistance through capacitive gate coupling. It resolves the electron and previously inaccessible hole transitions in the same bilayer MoSe2 device, whose carriers share disorder but not mass. items.title: MarketRank: ranking stocks by the stationary probabilities of a Markov chain over estimated money flows, with a topological landscape view
items.abstract: Every trading day, money leaves some stocks and moves into others. MarketRank asks where that money concentrates and how the concentration shifts over time. It treats the market as a Markov chain whose states are stocks. The chance of moving from one stock to another is the share of the first stock's outgoing dollars that goes to the second, and a stock's MarketRank score is its long run (stationary) probability in that chain, computed by damped power iteration on a sparse transition matrix. PageRank ranks web pages with the same idea, using links instead of dollars. Who sold what to buy what is not public, so the flows are estimated from daily prices and volumes with a correlation tilted gravity model, in a deterministic parallel C++ engine. items.title: Superconducting edge contact to a buried Ge quantum well
items.abstract: Semiconductor-superconductor hybrid systems form the basis for a broad range of quantum phenomena, such as Andreev bound states, topological superconductivity, and hybrid quantum Hall states. The performance of these hybrid systems can strongly benefit from the exceptional electronic properties of heterostructures with deeply buried quantum wells. However, establishing high-quality superconducting contacts to such quantum wells remains challenging. Here, we address this problem with an edge-contact approach that combines anisotropic dry etching to access the quantum well followed by wet etching for interface preparation. Josephson junctions fabricated using this approach consistently exhibit near-unity interface transparency, while quantum point contacts show strong Andreev enhancement, with the first conductance plateau approaching $4e^2/h$, the limit of perfect Andreev reflection. items.abstract: Engineering magnetism in two-dimensional semiconductors through interfacial interactions offers an attractive alternative to substitutional doping and provides opportunities for integrating magnetic and optoelectronic functionality within the same heterostructure. Here, we investigate ultrathin VOx films deposited on monolayer MoSe2 and demonstrate a pronounced enhancement of the magnetic response upon formation of the VOx/MoSe2 interface. Combined structural, spectroscopic, magnetic, and first-principles analyses support a consistent picture in which finite VOx clusters possess intrinsic magnetic moments that are further enhanced by electron transfer from MoSe2 to the oxide. items.title: Squeezed light from a semiconductor amplifier
items.abstract: The possibility of generating light in a squeezed quantum state during saturated light amplification in a semiconductor amplifier is theoretically analyzed. Due to four-wave mixing process during amplification, weak components of the spontaneous emission of the medium with symmetric frequency shifts relative to the strong amplified wave acquire the quantum properties of two-mode squeezed light. The squeezing of quadrature components occurs in the range of frequency shifts of several GHz ($\sim$ the inverse relaxation time of the charge carrier density) and can reach 10 dB or more under optimal conditions. The formation of a two-mode squeezing phase facilitates the observation of the squeezing effect, in which a strong wave, playing the role of a local wave, exhibits quadrature noise suppression without additional homodyne detection.

items.title: Two-exciton bound states in the Merrifield exciton model
items.abstract: Understanding the formation and dynamics of two-exciton bound states (BSs) is crucial for harnessing multi-exciton phenomena and designing next-generation organic semiconductor materials. While various mechanisms such as intermolecular exciton-exciton interactions or multi-level intramolecular configurations can generate these BSs, a fundamental understanding of their underlying lattice dynamics remains a key challenge. Within this context, the Merrifield exciton model stands out as a premier framework for capturing the intricate quantum mixing between single-site doubly-excited states and two-particle scattering continuum. In this work, by constructing a set of exact two-exciton Bloch states and applying a plane-wave ansatz to treat the resulting inhomogeneous tridiagonal matrices, we provide a complete, rigorous solution to the two-exciton problem in a finite-size Merrifield chain. items.title: Sparse qubit operation in a 6$\times$6 quantum dot array
items.abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum computation requires increasing the qubit count while maintaining high performance and connectivity. Semiconductor qubits have demonstrated high-fidelity operation, but growing the system size at sufficient connectivity remains challenging, such that scaling mainly occurred in one spatial direction to preserve access for control lines in the other. Here, we realise an approach that relaxes the requirements on fabrication and demonstrate a 6$\times$6 quantum dot array, defined by a shared barrier gate and individual plunger gates. The quantum dots are tuned through coherent spin shuttling over distances up to 5.2um into a sparse configuration of 10 simultaneously operated qubits, leaving space for shuttling connections. items.title: CacheFit: The Rising Cost of Cache Replacement and Constraint-Driven Redesign of Last-Level Cache Replacement Policies
items.abstract: The latency, power, and area costs of LLC replacement remain poorly explored not because simulators cannot be instrumented--event counters feeding a power model are routine--but because no cost model takes a replacement policy as input. CACTI and McPAT price regular structures, a cache or a core, not the small, oddly shaped arrays and dependent logic a policy is made of, and no event count reveals a victim-selection path's logic depth. Without a model, cost has never been an objective a policy search could optimize. In practice, a policy is first selected in simulation for its IPC, and its cost is reduced later in RTL, after the algorithm is fixed. Cost thus enters the design too late to shape it. items.title: 2d-fet-bench: from spatial reasoning to fet design on flakes
items.abstract: Field-effect transistor (FET) layouts on exfoliated two-dimensional flakes are typically drawn by hand for each flake, placing contacts and gates to match its position and outline in optical micrographs. To our knowledge, no executable benchmark tests whether language-model agents can perform this flake-specific construction reliably. We introduce 2D-FET-Bench V2, a benchmark of 128 layout tasks built from microscopy-derived flake contours, including hole-containing flakes and multi-flake tasks. Each task supplies a textual device specification and contour coordinates. An agent generates typed polygon and path operations rendered to GDSII. A deterministic verifier checks geometric and structural requirements, and a separate integrity check verifies that the supplied contours remain unchanged. items.title: Simplified Swarm Optimization for Surrogate-Assisted Reliability Design of Insulated-Gate Bipolar Transistor Power Modules Using an Open-Source Process Finite-Element Model
items.abstract: Process-induced warpage, ceramic stress and solder strain limit the reliability of insulated-gate bipolar transistor (IGBT) modules on direct-bonded copper (DBC) substrates. Surrogate-assisted design studies train regression models on finite-element analysis (FEA) databases, but rarely check the optimized designs against new FEA or report how surrogate error interacts with the optimizer. This paper builds and evaluates an open pipeline: an open-source process finite-element model, surrogates tuned by Simplified Swarm Optimization (SSO), multi-objective design search, FEA confirmation of selected designs and confirmation-driven infill. The model starts at the second reflow and reproduces measured warpage within 18.2%, 33.6% and 15.3% at the reflow, housing and molding stages without fitted parameters. items.abstract: The optical properties of monolayer transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs) are strongly impacted by exciton-phonon coupling, especially inter-valley scattering in the case of tungsten-based materials. Considering exemplarily the resonance Raman profile of the A$_1$-mode in hBN-encapsulated monolayer WSe$_2$, we find that inter-valley scattering between the electronic K- and Q-valley leads to destructive interference between a first order and a third order Raman process. items.abstract: Strain engineering is a leading route to control valley-selective transport in monolayer transition metal dichalcogenides. Whether this quantum effect survives inside a fully contacted device remains an open question. items.abstract: Measuring rapid astrophysical phenomena requires many short exposures, which suffer from repeated read noise. items.abstract: The unprecedented computational scale of modern artificial intelligence depends on complex, multi-billion-transistor Systems-on-Chip, yet the workflows that verify these chips remain stubbornly manual. items.title: Interplay between Excitability and Noise in Analog Spiking Neurons
items.abstract: A spiking neuron is a dynamical system exhibiting a limit cycle (a spike) when subject to sufficiently excitatory input. Famous neuroscience experiments by Bryant and Segundo as well as Mainen and Sejnowski revealed that the spike times of some biological neurons are more reliable when subject to time-varying stimuli compared to constant ones. Provided with an industrial physics-based transient noise SPICE simulation framework compatible with foundry transistor compact models, we have demonstrated similar behaviours for a CMOS analog spiking neuron designed for neuromorphic computing hardware platforms. items.abstract: Photonic quantum technologies require the integration of high-quality quantum light sources with programmable photonic circuitry to enable on-chip quantum information processing. Semiconductor quantum dots have emerged as a leading platform for quantum light generation, yet their monolithic integration with cryogenic-compatible, programmable photonic circuitry remains challenging. Here we demonstrate a programmable quantum photonic platform that enables simultaneous control of highly coherent quantum dot-based single photon emitters and reconfigurable optical elements at cryogenic temperatures. System-level integration enables individual electrical and optical addressing of active components on a single chip, allowing their concurrent operation while preserving coherent non-classical light emission. We demonstrate multiple quantum-photonic functionalities, including pure single-photon ge...

Acceleration of Data Analytics on Heterogeneous Supercloud Systems
items.abstract: Heterogeneous Supercloud systems are transforming data analytics by enabling scalable and efficient task distribution across diverse resources. This paper presents computational models and performance estimation techniques tailored for accelerating Dense Cholesky (CH) Decomposition and Singular Value Decomposition (SVD)-based analytics on Heterogeneous Superclouds. Our ReDSEa tool-chain automates mapping, load balancing, scheduling, parallelism, and computation overlap. Implemented on a heterogeneous system with a Huawei Kunpeng 920 ARM CPU and an Ascend 910 AI accelerator, our LLVM compiler tool-chain employs novel performance models for recursive, iterative, and blocked computations, achieving up to 17x speedup for CH and 88x for SVD over fully optimized 48-core CPU implementations.

Four modulators are considered an InP electro absorption modulator, a LiNbO3 dual drive Mach Zehnder modulator, a dual parallel Mach Zehnder modulator and a silicon carrier depletion modulator

items.title: Time frequency distributions of optical sources (I): directly modulated semiconductor lasers
items.abstract: We develop a time frequency framework for the dynamics of directly modulated semiconductor lasers in which the optical field obtained from the singlemode rate equations is represented by distributions of Cohen class. Closed form small signal solutions are derived for RC filtered square current pulses and for sinusoidal modulation, including the exact chirp to power ratio with gain compression and spontaneous emission and a line expansion of the Wigner distribution of the sinusoidally modulated field. Kernels satisfying two known conditions return the laser chirp as the first conditional moment.

items.title: Feature identification for parameter extraction and defect detection using machine learning
items.abstract: Process control of advanced semiconductor nodes is not only pushing the limits of metrology equipment requirements in terms of resolution and throughput but also in terms of the richness of data to be extracted to enable engineers to finetune the process steps for increased yield. The move towards 3D structures requires extraction of critical dimension parameters from structures which can vary largely from layer to layer. For in-line process control, the necessary automation forces the development of layer and equipment-specific dedicated image processing algorithms. Similarly, with the increase in stochastic defects in the EUV era, detection of defects at the nm scale requires the identification of features captured in low resolution to meet the throughput requirements of HVM fabs, which can again lead to custom algorithm development. items.title: Image resolution enhancement for advanced semiconductor nodes
items.abstract: Advanced semiconductor nodes are pushing the limits of feature sizes and require metrology with sub-nm resolution without compromising on the throughput as needed for in-line process control. Recently, high-throughput scanning probe microscopy (SPM) based metrology and inspection tools capable of meeting these needs have been introduced to the market and qualified for use in HVM. While innovative measurement methods and tool architecture have allowed for a leap of improvement in throughput, the next step in further reducing imaging time can be obtained through the application of machine learning for enhancing the resolution of measured images for extraction of relevant parameters. In this work, we provide the general framework under which a neural network-based resolution enhancer is designed and used for SPM images. items.title: Field-free dual superconducting diode via photon-assisted interference
items.abstract: Non-reciprocal transport underpins key functionalities in signal processing and logic; however, conventional semiconductor diodes exhibit reduced performance at sub-Kelvin temperatures. As cryogenic electronics continue to scale, there is increasing demand for diode operation compatible with low-temperature and low-dissipation conditions. This need has driven the development of alternatives to p-n junctions that rely on non-reciprocal electron transport mechanisms efficient in the deep-cryogenic regime. Superconducting devices constitute a natural low-loss platform, yet most existing superconducting diodes are restricted to either Cooper-pair or quasiparticle transport, often requiring complex material stacks, asymmetric geometries, or external magnetic fields. No single, geometrically symmetric junction has yet integrated rectification across both transport channels to achieve vanishing...

items.title: New dimensions in magnetism and superconductivity via 3D nanoprinting with focused electron and ion beams
items.abstract: The extension of nanoscale quantum materials to the third dimension brings new possibilities to geometrically tune emergent properties, emulating or indeed going beyond the physics of bulk materials, with exciting implications for high-density technological integration. Realising such three-dimensional architectures requires nanofabrication techniques that not only enable complex 3D geometries, but also deliver functional quantum materials with emergent phenomena. Recent advances in focused electron- and ion-beam induced deposition (FEBID and FIBID) have made 3D nanopatterning of functional materials in complex geometries increasingly feasible, paving the way for the experimental realisation of new phenomena and device prototyping. In this review, we discuss the use of FEBID and FIBID 3D nanopatterning of superconducting and magnetic materials. We address the underlying mechanisms, and c...

items.abstract: Amid the intensifying competition in artificial intelligence between the United States and China, the emergence of the DeepSeek-R1 model has sent significant ripples through the technology sector, capital markets, and policy circles. This Article offers a comprehensive analysis of legal and policy landscape surrounding DeepSeek, drawing upon its key technical features-including reinforcement learning, mixture-experts architecture, multi-head latent attention mechanism, knowledge distillation, and open-source approach. Firstly, DeepSeek's success raises crtitical questions about the efficacy of the United States' increasingly robust export control measures on chips and semiconductors, components essential for training large language models. items.title: A numerical and efficient model for thermo-field electron emission calculations
items.abstract: As electron sources are reduced in size, fabricated in new materials, or pushed for performance, the analytical formulations for thermo-field electron emission, namely Fowler-Nordheim and Murphy-Good equations and their JWKB-based extensions, are increasingly applied out of the range of conditions for which they were derived. We present GETELEC-3, an open-source code that replaces them with a direct numerical solution of the one-dimensional time-independent Schrödinger equation (1D-TISE). Several methods to solve the 1D-TISE have been implemented to test for speed, robustness, and solution's uncertainty. items.title: Radio-frequency electron cascade in semiconductor quantum dots
items.abstract: Electron cotunneling in semiconductor quantum dots is a higher-order tunneling mechanism that connects initial and final charge states through energetically inaccessible virtual intermediate configurations. In quantum-dot arrays, such processes can produce simultaneous charge motion across multiple tunnel junctions and enable transitions that would otherwise be suppressed by Coulomb blockade. Here, building on an earlier proof-of-principle demonstration, we investigate radio-frequency (rf)-driven correlated cotunneling and its application to dispersive quantum-dot readout. Using both theoretical modeling and experimental measurements in two different foundry-fabricated silicon devices, we show that an external rf drive can induce correlated cyclic single-electron transitions, resulting in enhanced charge-polarization of the system. items.title: Identifying Plastic Inorganic Semiconductors Requires More Rigorous Criteria
items.abstract: The identification of plastic inorganic semiconductors becomes challenging when their mechanical responses depend on crystallographic orientation, sample size, and loading conditions. Using layered GeSe as a model system, we examine its deformation behavior through macroscopic compression, bending, conventional micropillar compression, and eccentric micropillar compression. Under macroscopic compression perpendicular to the layers, GeSe sustains approximately 23% strain without fracture, whereas bending along the c-axis armchair direction produces brittle cleavage fracture. Conventional micropillar compression results in brittle fragmentation, while eccentric loading introduces a shear component that activates pronounced interlayer sliding and accommodates deformation. items.title: When LLMs Sit Above Diagnostic Tools: Unrealized Complementarity in Industrial Fault Diagnosis
items.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as integration layers above specialized tools, but a stronger component does not necessarily produce a stronger combined system. Across five diagnostic datasets (bearing vibration, process monitoring, semiconductor equipment), we study whether an LLM can reliably use external diagnostic information; paired repeat calls separate advice effects from output instability. In all five, conflicting external information overturned initially correct LLM judgments. Among the four datasets with direct integration comparisons, none showed a consistent advantage for implicit LLM integration over the stronger standalone source. On a Tennessee Eastman confirmation set whose protocol was fixed before evaluation, unaided accuracy was 64.67%, implicit LLM-specialist integration 77.43%, and the specialist alone 83.33%. items.title: A FeFET Voltage-to-Time Converter with Offset Trim by Programmed Multilevel State in 28-nm CMOS
items.abstract: The offset and gain of voltage-to-time converters (VTCs) in time-domain circuits vary with process, supply, and temperature. This work presents a VTC whose nonvolatile input-referred offset trim is the programmed multilevel state of the ferroelectric field-effect transistor (FeFET) that converts the input. Fabricated in 28-nm CMOS, the 6.07-$μ$m$^2$ VTC consists of a current-starved inverter with the FeFET and a parallel NMOS leaker in its tail, a capacitor bank, and a following inverter. The programmed state shifts the transfer curve onto the input range, leaving the gain to the capacitor bank and the leaker bias. Measured at 10~MS/s, centered states weaken the second harmonic from $-$12.5~dB in the low-threshold state to $-$32.2~dB and lower the static integral nonlinearity (INL) at 5~bit from 2.42 to 0.92~LSB. items.title: Floquet dressing of bulk metallic bands in 2H-NbSe2
items.abstract: Floquet dressing offers a route to controlling electronic states through periodic optical driving. Its realization in solids has centred primarily on topological-insulator surface states, semiconductors and two-dimensional Dirac semimetals. Extending this control to bulk metals would enable manipulation of the itinerant states underlying metallic transport and collective order. Yet strong screening and rapid scattering have long cast doubt on its feasibility in bulk metals, while photoelectron dressing complicates its identification. Here we identify Floquet dressing of the overlapping, bulk-derived metallic bands of 2H-NbSe2 using time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy. Photon-shifted replicas in a sparse unoccupied-state window retain the parent-band dispersions and appear only during pump--probe overlap. items.title: Long-lived Coherent Phonons Reveal Competing Thermal and Many-Body Dynamics in $α$-In$_{2}$Se$_{3}$
items.abstract: The fate of quantum coherence following photoexcitation is a central problem in nonequilibrium condensed-matter physics, especially in low-dimensional solids where electronic, structural and many-body energy scales are strongly coupled. Here, we investigate this interplay in ferroelectric $α$-In$_{2}$Se$_{3}$ using broadband transient-grating spectroscopy with $\sim$5 fs laser pulses. Photoexcitation launches pronounced oscillations dominated by a $\sim$104 cm$^{-1}$ mode that persists for several picoseconds. Measurements from 10 to 300 K show that its frequency remains nearly unchanged while its coherence is progressively suppressed, distinguishing the lattice coordinate from thermally activated dephasing. items.abstract: Sub-terahertz (sub-THz) low-phase-noise signal sources commonly employ frequency multiplier chains to extend the operating frequency of lower-frequency oscillators. This paper presents the design and simulations of a wideband, high-output-power frequency multiplier implemented in TSMC 65 nm CMOS technology. items.title: RAPID: Row-Parallel Arithmetic Processing in DRAM
items.abstract: Processing-using-memory (PUM) architectures perform computation directly within DRAM to reduce costly data movement between memory and processors. Because charge-sharing operations are confined to individual bitlines, existing DRAM-PUM architectures reorganize data into column-oriented, bit-serial representations. items.abstract: Clock meshes are used in high-performance VLSI designs to minimize skew and tolerate on-chip variation, but they spend scarce routing resources on premium metal layers. Backside power delivery creates a new option: it adds thick, low-resistance metal layers on the back of the wafer, and the power grid does not consume all of them. Flip-flops remain on the frontside; a backside mesh therefore cannot drive them directly, and every connection passes through a through-silicon via. We present the first design-space exploration of backside clock meshes, implemented in OpenROAD on GT2N, a 2 nm nanosheet technology. Four benchmarks (1,938 to 15,311 flip-flops) are explored with multi-objective Bayesian optimization, and every design point is verified by transistor-level SPICE simulation, since the cyclic mesh cannot be evaluated by static timing analysis. items.title: Vacancy aggregation enhances NV- spin coherence in diamond: a cluster-correlation-expansion study of multi-vacancy spin baths in semiconductors
items.abstract: Annealing a semiconductor makes its vacancies mobile; they aggregate into multi-vacancy complexes that often carry spin. Such centres are a magnetic-noise source for any spin qubit among them, in silicon and silicon carbide as well as in diamond, and they are accordingly blamed for NV-decoherence in irradiated and implanted diamond, with two coherence records credited to removing them. items.abstract: Electron-phonon interactions renormalize phonon frequencies and lifetimes and are central to the dynamical properties of solids. While these effects are usually described within linear electron-phonon coupling, the role of nonlinear electron-phonon interactions for phonon properties remains largely unexplored. In this work, we study phonon renormalization arising from the long-range linear one-electron-one-phonon and the nonlinear one-electron-two-phonon interactions within a diagrammatic framework. We derive the corresponding self-energy diagrams, which depend on the chemical potential and temperature, and evaluate them from first principles for the two polar semiconductors LiF and KTaO$_3$. items.title: Continuous-Wave Operation at 30 MV/m of a Superconducting Radio-Frequency Gun Cryomodule with an Exchangeable Cathode Plug
items.abstract: A prototype 185.7 MHz superconducting radio-frequency (SRF) electron gun cryomodule has been developed for the proposed LCLS-II-HE Low Emittance Injector at SLAC. It has an in-situ ultra-high-vacuum exchangeable cathode plug system compatible with semiconductor photocathodes. With a copper plug, the gun achieved continuous-wave RF operation at a cathode field of 30 MV/m. No measurable degradation was observed after plug removal and reinsertion with the cavity at 4.4 K. This result is a significant improvement over past continuous-wave SRF gun systems with exchangeable plugs.

items.title: Compact Modeling of Oxide-Semiconductor, 2D Material, Carbon Nanotube, and Cryogenic Transistors with Experiment Verification
items.abstract: This paper presents a unified compact model for emerging transistor technologies, including oxide-semiconductor field-effect transistors (OSFETs), 2D material FETs (2DFETs), carbon nanotube FETs (CNFETs), and cryogenic MOSFETs. A unified charge-density formulation is developed to account for quantum confinement, trap charges, and band-tail states in channel charge calculations. Scaling models are incorporated to accurately describe 2D electrostatic effects. Cryogenic operation is modeled through the inclusion of band-tail states and temperature-dependent mobility and threshold voltage. items.title: Inverse-Designed High-Q/V Silicon Nitride Photonic Crystal Cavities for Second- and Third-Harmonic Generation
items.abstract: SiN photonic crystal (PhC) cavities are promising platforms for nonlinear and quantum photonics because of their wide transparency window, CMOS compatibility, and negligible two-photon absorption. However, realizing high-Q/V cavities remains challenging because of the relatively low refractive index of SiN. Here, we employ inverse design to optimize a two-dimensional SiN PhC cavity and experimentally demonstrate a quality factor of approximately 80,000, the highest reported for a near-stoichiometric SiN 2D PhC cavity. Furthermore, both second- and third-harmonic generation are observed from the same cavity, providing experimental evidence of strong optical confinement and large Q/V. Our results establish inverse-designed SiN PhC cavities as a promising platform for nonlinear photonics and future heterogeneous integrated photonic devices.

items.title: Magnetic enhancement and Hall conductivity of excitonic insulators in a Gross--Neveu type model
items.abstract: We study the effects of a perpendicular magnetic field on the excitonic insulator (EI) phase in the semiconductor regime using an extended planar four-Fermi model. Within the large-$N$ approximation, we determine the coupled scalar and excitonic condensates at finite temperature, chemical potential, and magnetic field. The field enhances the EI condensate and raises its critical temperature, providing an excitonic realization of magnetic catalysis, while the scalar condensate remains constant throughout the EI phase. By contrast, the critical chemical potential depends nonmonotonically on the field because of the successive occupation of Landau levels. The magnetic field also shifts the mean-field tricritical point and enlarges the first-order region of the temperature--chemical-potential phase diagram. We further analyze the Hall conductivity and find that increasing the field reduces t...

items.title: Symmetry-Enforced Dirac Fermions and Structural Metastability in Pentagonal Monolayers of Transition-Metal Ditellurides
items.abstract: The recent synthesis of pentagonal PdTe$_2$ monolayer motivates broader research interests in transition-metal ditellurides whose electronic phases are governed by symmetry and structural reconstruction. The pentagonal phase of transition-metal ditellurides exhibits electronic properties that are dramatically different from those of its hexagonal counterpart due to its lower crystalline symmetry. Using first-principles calculations, we study monolayer $X$Te$_2$ ($X=\mathrm{Pd},\mathrm{Pt},\mathrm{Ni}$) in both hexagonal and pentagonal polymorphs. By constructing a continuous structural interpolation between the hexagonal and pentagonal phases, we show that the semimetal (hex)-to-semiconductor (penta) transition occurs only after an intermediate structural threshold rather than at the onset of symmetry reduction. The gap opening coincides with the formation of Te--Te dimers, which drive t...

items.title: Classical Reversible Computation by Quantum Coherence
items.abstract: Rising energy demand from data-center and AI applications has renewed interest in reversible computation, where logic need not dissipate heat at every step if information is uncomputed. Implementations have so far been classical: adiabatic CMOS recovers part of the switching energy but still moves thousands of $k_BT$ per logic node at room temperature. Here we propose classical reversible logic implemented by coherent spin dynamics in a spin quantum-dot array, with inputs and outputs in classical basis states and no algorithmic use of superposition. The same spin stores, transports, and computes, with unitary rotation replacing irreversible switching. The universal building block is an iToffoli gate driven by DC voltage pulses and exchange between hole spins in Ge/SiGe quantum dots. Simulations with realistic model parameters reproduce the Toffoli truth table and yield a testable error l...

items.title: Complex frequency-dependent quadrature squeezing in semiconductor lasers
items.abstract: We present a comprehensive study of quadrature squeezing in a quantum well laser based on a fully quantum Langevin approach. We compute the frequency-resolved squeezing map of the laser field and identify optimal squeezing curves, revealing, for the first time to our knowledge, both frequency-dependent squeezing and complex or hidden squeezing in a semiconductor laser. We further analyse the role of the linewidth enhancement factor (alpha-factor) in the emergence of these features. Our results establish semiconductor lasers as a platform for the generation of non-classical light and open new perspectives for their application in quantum communication and sensing.

items.title: Pyroelectric and electrocaloric properties of core-shell HfxZr1-xO2 nanoparticles: theory and experiment
items.abstract: Nanosized hafnia-zirconia (HfxZr1-xO2) in the form of thin films, multilayers, and nanoparticles is one of the most promising CMOS-compatible ferroelectric materials for advanced electronic memories and logic devices. Using the Landau-Ginzburg-Devonshire free energy functional with trilinear and biquadratic couplings of polar, nonpolar, and antipolar order parameters, we analyze the pyroelectric and electrocaloric properties in an ensemble of spherical core-shell HfxZr1-xO2 nanoparticles. To test the theoretical model, we experimentally measured the temperature dependence of the electric charge accumulated in pressed powders consisting of oxygen-deficient core-shell Hf0.5Zr0.5O2 nanoparticles with an average size of 7 nm. The observed temperature-dependent behavior of the accumulated charge and its derivative are in qualitative agreement with the calculated polarization and pyroelectric...

items.title: Anharmonic Quantum Transport Analysis of Thermal Transport Anomalies in Ultrathin Silicon Nanowires
items.abstract: Thermal transport in low-dimensional semiconductors is important for nanoelectronics, quantum devices, and thermoelectrics. Recent molecular dynamics (MD) studies reveal a nonmonotonic diameter dependence of thermal conductivity in ultrathin silicon nanowires (NWs), but classical MD is limited at low temperatures and under strong confinement. Here, we investigate this anomaly using anharmonic non-equilibrium Green's function (NEGF) simulations combined with density functional theory-trained neuroevolution potentials. All transport results are expressed as effective thermal conductivities ($κ_{\mathrm{eff}}$) for NW devices with a finite channel length of $L=10$ nm. At 300 K, $κ_{\mathrm{eff}}$ decreases with diameter to minima at 6.24 and 5.50 nm for [001]- and [110]-oriented NWs, respectively. At 10 K, the corresponding minima occur at 7.33 and 5.50 nm. items.title: Provisioning to Runtime Optimization of a 100 MW-Scale AI Cluster
items.abstract: The electric power supply for AI data centers is now the most significant bottleneck in the race toward Artificial General Intelligence, surpassing even the constraint of AI accelerator availability. To our knowledge, this paper is the first to describe the end-to-end power management process for a hyper-scale AI datacenter; from early power planning to accommodate next-generation accelerators 6--12 months before their general availability, to tuning power settings after large scale deployment, and finally to dynamic, runtime power management for evolving workloads. We present detailed power measurements for a 150 MW datacenter hosting a cluster of 83K GB200 GPUs. We share insights from building this state-of-the-art AI cluster. We hope this work encourages practitioners across the industry to share their own experiences as well.

items.title: Predictive Software Scheduling as an Early-Warning Hint Layer for Optical Engine Thermal Drift in Heterogeneous SoIC Packaging
items.abstract: As semiconductor scaling approaches the A16 / 2 nm node, the integration of co-packaged optics (CPO) through TSMC's Compact Universal Photonic Engine (COUPE) architecture introduces critical thermal-optical coupling challenges. Micro-ring resonators embedded in the Photonic Integrated Circuit (PIC) layer are highly sensitive to temperature, with a wafer-level center wavelength deviation of merely +/-1.7 nm across a 300 mm wafer representing the platform's manufacturing control limit. To address this, we propose XRM-SSD V24, a physics-aware scheduling layer that models inference-load density 20-50 ms before execution and issues early-warning hints to the COUPE bias-control firmware, enabling pre-emptive thermal compensation. Simulation-based validation on a software emulation platform (physical characterization pending TSMC tape-out) over 90,000 inference steps yields a simulator-internal...

items.title: Speed Kills: Exploring Confused Deputy Attacks Through Edge AI Accelerators
items.abstract: AI Accelerators (AIAs) are specialized hardware, such as Tensor Processing Units (TPUs), that enable optimal and efficient execution of AI applications and on-device inference. The growing demand for AI applications has led to the widespread adoption of AIAs on edge and embedded devices. Unlike applications, AIAs are not bound by Operating System (OS) restrictions and have limited visibility into Application Processor (AP) security mechanisms (e.g., kernel versus application memory and process isolation). This semantic gap can lead to confused deputy vulnerabilities, where an AIA can be tricked by a malicious application into performing privileged operations on its behalf. In this paper, we conduct the first in-depth study of Confused Deputy Attacks (CDAs) using AIAs. We design DeputyHunt, a Large Language Model (LLM)-assisted framework to extract CDA-relevant information for a given AIA...

items.title: Joint Architecture-Token-Bitwidth Multi-Axis Optimization of Vision Transformers for Semiconductor IC Packaging
items.abstract: Vision Transformers (ViTs) have achieved strong performance in visual recognition, yet their deployment in resource-constrained industrial environments remains limited. The main challenges are their high computational cost, memory requirements, and energy consumption. While individual efficiency techniques such as neural architecture search (NAS), token compression, and low-precision inference have been extensively studied, most prior work targets only a single optimization axis, limiting overall deployment gains while preserving accuracy. In this paper, we present one of the first holistic frameworks that jointly optimizes three complementary axes: architecture, token, and bit-width. Specifically, the framework identifies compact backbones via Neural Architecture Search (AutoFormer), reduces information processing via token merging (ToMe), and accelerates per-operation execution via fp1...

items.title: Proximitized Topological Insulator Charge Island Fabricated via In Situ Multi-Angle Stencil Lithography
items.abstract: Hybrid superconductor-topological insulator (TI) nanostructures constitute a promising material platform for exploring proximity-induced superconductivity in systems with topologically protected surface states. A key obstacle has been the realization of clean and well-controlled superconductor-TI interfaces, as TI surfaces rapidly degrade under ambient conditions. Here, we introduce a fully in situ, multi-angle stencil lithography technique that enables the fabrication of proximitized charge islands in TIs. The approach combines selective area growth of (Bi,Sb)$_2$Te$_3$ nanoribbons with angle-controlled deposition of diffusion barriers, superconducting Al, and ultrathin oxide tunnel barriers, allowing scalable fabrication of hybrid nanostructures without post-growth processing. Low-temperature transport measurements reveal robust Coulomb blockade and a pronounced suppression of low-ener...

items.title: Spin Qubit Leapfrogging: Dynamics of shuttling electrons on top of another
items.abstract: Spin shuttling has crystalized as a powerful and promising tool for establishing intermediate-range connectivity in semiconductor spin-qubit devices. Although experimental demonstrations have performed exceptionally well on different materials platforms, the question of how to handle areas of low valley splitting in silicon during shuttling remains unresolved. In this work, we explore the possibility of utilizing the valley degree of freedom, particularly in regions of low valley splitting, to allow mobile spin qubits to be shuttled through an occupied stationary quantum dot, thereby leapfrogging over the stationary electron. This not only grants a more enriched mobility for shuttled electrons, as it opens new possible routing paths, but also enables the implementation of an entangling SWAP$^γ$ two-qubit gate operation in the process.
